steps.note: session_id reuse skips the whole create block (including its navigation) — without this the flow would run on whatever page the session was left on

args.note: galaxy expired -> signed TGC exchange mints a fresh AT in-place; telemetry only, verdict gate stays the decider (re-run the flow if renewed mid-run; import_curl if TGC is dead)

steps.note: decision layer: classify where the ping-pong wait landed (issue #73) — the xiaohongshu.com/login rule reads the 401 bounce as login; upload-content reads landed
walled/dead-login → jump to the takeover throw instead of grinding the 20s upload-content wait into a timeout that names nothing (issue #72)

args.script:
// xhs-post step 2: login-wall telemetry — no expect here: the 401 redirect ping-pongs (login bounces back via lastUrl, then 401 again), so a point-in-time URL check can pass mid-pong; the hard gate was the verdict branch above
JSON.stringify({url: location.href, need_login: location.href.includes('/login'), title: document.title})

steps.note: the real form marker, not div.upload-content: the 401-bounce login page carries a decorative upload-content div too (seen live 2026-09-23), so that selector can false-positive this wait mid ping-pong and push the failure downstream as 'no file input'

args.predicate: (function(){var ws=document.querySelectorAll('xhs-publish-btn');for(var i=0;i<ws.length;i++){var w=ws[i];if(w.getAttribute('is-publish')==='false')continue;if(w.getAttribute('submit-disabled')!=='true')return true}var bs=document.querySelectorAll('.publish-page-publish-btn button.bg-red');for(var j=0;j<bs.length;j++){var b=bs[j];if(!b.disabled&&b.getAttribute('aria-disabled')!=='true')return true}return false})()

steps.note: positive assertion: the success page, explicitly excluding /login — the old negative form (!includes('/publish/publish')) counted the 401 login bounce as success (false green, real-send 2026-09-19)
complement of the verdict gate: clean run → jump past the takeover throw to the end marker (fall-through would otherwise execute it)

args.script: throw new Error('xhs verdict gate: verdict=' + JSON.stringify({{v}}) + ' — cookie expired or risk wall. Re-import login via import_curl (cookies are short-lived here), then rerun this flow with the revived session_id')

steps.note: fail receipt carries the diagnostic screenshot + saved fact sheet; the human takes over from /live?session=<id>
